handbookNote: Kentucky Driver Manual, published by the Kentucky State Police (revision dated 10-11-2023), fetched directly from the official PDF linked off drive.ky.gov's Testing Requirements page at wp.kentuckystatepolice.ky.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Kentucky-Driver-Manual-10-11-2023.pdf -- both drive.ky.gov (Kentucky Transportation Cabinet) and kentuckystatepolice.ky.gov are official .gov sources, and KSP is the agency that both writes the manual and administers the knowledge test. Full text extracted with pdftotext and saved to temp/handbooks/ky/driver.txt. Real exam mechanics: the manual itself states on p.10 (Written Test section) that 'Applicants must make a minimum score of 80% to pass this test' -- CONFIRMED directly from the official manual. The total number of questions on the actual written knowledge test and whether it is timed are NOT published anywhere in the manual or on the two official KSP pages checked (kentuckystatepolice.ky.gov/driver-testing and its Testing FAQs section) -- both were fetched and searched with no result, so these two figures are left explicitly UNCONFIRMED rather than guessed; only the 80% passing threshold is stated as fact. The manual also confirms testing is available orally and in 12 languages via tablet devices at KSP posts. This is an unusually rich, detailed 71-page manual covering GDL phases in granular age-bracketed detail (permit/intermediate/full phases, 60-hour/10-night practice log, curfews, passenger restrictions, points system with 12-point/7-point thresholds), DUI law with exact BAC thresholds and penalty ranges, full rules-of-the-road (signs/signals/markings/right-of-way/roundabouts), sharing-the-road content for pedestrians/bicyclists/motorcyclists/commercial vehicles/ATVs/animal-drawn vehicles, work zones, railroad crossings, autocycles, and trailering -- comfortably supporting a large, non-repetitive, well-grounded question bank. Price matches this project's established fixed Driver-track rate of $4.99; every question is grounded in a specific cited passage of the fetched official manual text, or (for a small number of CDL/hazmat logistics facts) the companion official KSP Driver Testing FAQ page -- none are invented.
